lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 你爸爸媽媽結婚三十年了，怎麼年年七夕都特地去同一家小麵店慶祝？
lines.simplified: 你爸爸妈妈结婚三十年了，怎么年年七夕都特地去同一家小面店庆祝？
lines.pinyin: Nǐ bàba māma jiéhūn sānshí nián le, zěnme niánnián Qīxì dōu tèdì qù tóng yì jiā xiǎo miàndiàn qìngzhù?
lines.english: Your parents have been married thirty years. Why do they make a point of celebrating at the same little noodle shop every Qixi?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 這就要從他們第一次見面說起了。那天店裡客滿，老闆安排他們坐同一張桌子，我爸爸看了我媽媽一眼，就愛上她了。
lines.simplified: 这就要从他们第一次见面说起了。那天店里客满，老板安排他们坐同一张桌子，我爸爸看了我妈妈一眼，就爱上她了。
lines.pinyin: Zhè jiù yào cóng tāmen dì yī cì jiànmiàn shuō qǐ le. Nà tiān diàn lǐ kèmǎn, lǎobǎn ānpái tāmen zuò tóng yì zhāng zhuōzi, wǒ bàba kàn le wǒ māma yì yǎn, jiù ài shàng tā le.
lines.english: For that I have to start with the first time they met. The shop was full that day, so the owner sat them at the same table. My dad took one look at my mum and fell in love with her.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 真浪漫！後來呢？
lines.simplified: 真浪漫！后来呢？
lines.pinyin: Zhēn làngmàn! Hòulái ne?
lines.english: How romantic! And then?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 我媽媽離開的時候沒留電話，我爸爸只好天天去那家店，等了一個多月，總算又碰到她。
lines.simplified: 我妈妈离开的时候没留电话，我爸爸只好天天去那家店，等了一个多月，总算又碰到她。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ māma líkāi de shíhòu méi liú diànhuà, wǒ bàba zhǐhǎo tiāntiān qù nà jiā diàn, děng le yí ge duō yuè, zǒngsuàn yòu pèngdào tā.
lines.english: My mum left without giving her phone number, so my dad had no choice but to go to that shop every day. After waiting over a month, he finally ran into her again.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 男的爸爸為什麼天天去那家店？
prompt.simplified: 男的爸爸为什么天天去那家店？
prompt.pinyin: Nán de bàba wèishénme tiāntiān qù nà jiā diàn?
prompt.english: Why did the man's father go to that shop every day?

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 他們約好每天在店裡見面
choices.simplified: 他们约好每天在店里见面
choices.pinyin: Tāmen yuē hǎo měi tiān zài diàn lǐ jiànmiàn.
choices.english: They had agreed to meet at the shop every day.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 希望再遇到那天認識的人
choices.simplified: 希望再遇到那天认识的人
choices.pinyin: Xīwàng zài yùdào nà tiān rènshì de rén.
choices.english: He hoped to meet the person from that day again.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 店裡常常客滿，得早點去
choices.simplified: 店里常常客满，得早点去
choices.pinyin: Diàn lǐ chángcháng kèmǎn, děi zǎo diǎn qù.
choices.english: The shop was often full, so he had to go early.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Tā xiǎng qǐng lǎobǎn bāngmáng zhǎo tā.
choices.english: He wanted to ask the owner to help find her.

questions.why: Put the two turns together: she left no phone number (沒留電話), so the shop where they met was his only chance of seeing her again; that is why he went every day until he 總算 ran into her. They had made no arrangement (with no number, they could not have), 客滿 belongs to the first evening, and he never asks the owner for help: 只好 says waiting at the shop was all he could do.

focus.zh: （這）就要從……說起了；兩句合起來看
focus.en: to explain, start from…; combining two turns

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 妳以前連泡麵都不想自己煮，怎麼最近天天在廚房忙？
lines.simplified: 你以前连泡面都不想自己煮，怎么最近天天在厨房忙？
lines.pinyin: Nǐ yǐqián lián pàomiàn dōu bù xiǎng zìjǐ zhǔ, zěnme zuìjìn tiāntiān zài chúfáng máng?
lines.english: You used to not even bother making instant noodles yourself. How come you've been busy in the kitchen every day lately?

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 這就要從上個月說起了。我奶奶住院，醫院的飯她吃不下去，我只好按照她教我的方法煮，每天送到病房。
lines.simplified: 这就要从上个月说起了。我奶奶住院，医院的饭她吃不下去，我只好按照她教我的方法煮，每天送到病房。
lines.pinyin: Zhè jiù yào cóng shàng ge yuè shuō qǐ le. Wǒ nǎinai zhùyuàn, yīyuàn de fàn tā chī bú xiàqù, wǒ zhǐhǎo ànzhào tā jiāo wǒ de fāngfǎ zhǔ, měi tiān sòng dào bìngfáng.
lines.english: For that I have to start with last month. My grandma was in hospital and couldn't keep eating the hospital food, so I had to cook the way she taught me and take it to her ward every day.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 那她現在恢復得怎麼樣？
lines.simplified: 那她现在恢复得怎么样？
lines.pinyin: Nà tā xiànzài huīfù de zěnmeyàng?
lines.english: So how is she recovering?

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 已經出院了。她說我做的菜比她自己做的還好吃，我聽了很有信心，就越做越有興趣了。
lines.simplified: 已经出院了。她说我做的菜比她自己做的还好吃，我听了很有信心，就越做越有兴趣了。
lines.pinyin: Yǐjīng chūyuàn le. Tā shuō wǒ zuò de cài bǐ tā zìjǐ zuò de hái hǎochī, wǒ tīng le hěn yǒu xìnxīn, jiù yuè zuò yuè yǒu xìngqù le.
lines.english: She's already out of hospital. She said my cooking tastes even better than her own. That gave me confidence, and the more I cook, the more I enjoy it.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 女的為什麼對做菜有了興趣？
prompt.simplified: 女的为什么对做菜有了兴趣？
prompt.pinyin: Nǚ de wèishénme duì zuò cài yǒu le xìngqù?
prompt.english: Why has the woman become interested in cooking?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Nǎinai chī bú xià yīyuàn de fàn.
choices.english: Her grandmother couldn't eat the hospital food.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 她按照網路影片學會了
choices.simplified: 她按照网路影片学会了
choices.pinyin: Tā ànzhào wǎnglù yǐngpiàn xué huì le.
choices.english: She learned by following videos online.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 奶奶要她以後負責做飯
choices.simplified: 奶奶要她以后负责做饭
choices.pinyin: Nǎinai yào tā yǐhòu fùzé zuò fàn.
choices.english: Her grandmother wants her to do the cooking from now on.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 她做的菜得到奶奶的肯定
choices.simplified: 她做的菜得到奶奶的肯定
choices.pinyin: Tā zuò de cài dédào nǎinai de kěndìng.
choices.english: Her cooking won her grandmother's approval.

questions.why: Her interest grew because her grandmother said her cooking tasted better than her own (比她自己做的還好吃), which gave her confidence: approval made her keen. The hospital food is why she started cooking, not why she came to enjoy it, and she cooked the way her grandmother taught her, not from online videos.

focus.en: to explain, start from…; a reason

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 聽說你們社團上個星期去爬山，碰上了大雨？
lines.simplified: 听说你们社团上个星期去爬山，碰上了大雨？
lines.pinyin: Tīngshuō nǐmen shètuán shàng ge xīngqí qù páshān, pèng shàng le dàyǔ?
lines.english: I heard your club went hiking last week and got caught in heavy rain?

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 對啊。幸虧帶我們去的老師經驗豐富，一看到雲的顏色不對，就叫我們趕快下山，要不然我們恐怕就回不來了。
lines.simplified: 对啊。幸亏带我们去的老师经验丰富，一看到云的颜色不对，就叫我们赶快下山，要不然我们恐怕就回不来了。
lines.pinyin: Duì a. Xìngkuī dài wǒmen qù de lǎoshī jīngyàn fēngfù, yí kàndào yún de yánsè búduì, jiù jiào wǒmen gǎnkuài xià shān, yàobùrán wǒmen kǒngpà jiù huí bù lái le.
lines.english: Yes. Luckily the teacher who took us has a lot of experience. As soon as he saw the clouds were the wrong colour, he told us to hurry down the mountain; otherwise I'm afraid we wouldn't have made it back.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 那其他人呢？
lines.simplified: 那其他人呢？
lines.pinyin: Nà qítā rén ne?
lines.english: What about the others?

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 有一組人不聽他的，堅持繼續往上爬，結果到了半夜才被警察救下來。
lines.simplified: 有一组人不听他的，坚持继续往上爬，结果到了半夜才被警察救下来。
lines.pinyin: Yǒu yì zǔ rén bù tīng tā de, jiānchí jìxù wǎng shàng pá, jiéguǒ dào le bànyè cái bèi jǐngchá jiù xiàlái.
lines.english: One group didn't listen to him and insisted on climbing on. In the end the police didn't get them down until the middle of the night.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 女的那一組為什麼能平安回來？
prompt.simplified: 女的那一组为什么能平安回来？
prompt.pinyin: Nǚ de nà yì zǔ wèishénme néng píng'ān huílái?
prompt.english: Why did the woman's group get back safely?

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 半夜有警察上山救他們
choices.simplified: 半夜有警察上山救他们
choices.pinyin: Bànyè yǒu jǐngchá shàng shān jiù tāmen.
choices.english: The police came up the mountain at night to rescue them.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 他們等到雨停以後才下山
choices.simplified: 他们等到雨停以后才下山
choices.pinyin: Tāmen děngdào yǔ tíng yǐhòu cái xià shān.
choices.english: They waited until the rain stopped before coming down.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 他們接受了老師的建議
choices.simplified: 他们接受了老师的建议
choices.pinyin: Tāmen jiēshòu le lǎoshī de jiànyì.
choices.english: They took the teacher's advice.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 那天山上的雨很快就停了
choices.simplified: 那天山上的雨很快就停了
choices.pinyin: Nà tiān shān shàng de yǔ hěn kuài jiù tíng le.
choices.english: The rain on the mountain stopped quickly that day.

questions.why: 幸虧 names the lucky fact: the experienced teacher saw the clouds were wrong and told them to hurry down, and they did; 要不然 says what would have happened otherwise. Being rescued by the police belongs to the other group, the one that would not listen; they went down at once rather than waiting out the rain, and the rain stopping is never said.

focus.zh: 幸虧……，要不然……；兩句合起來看

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 妳今天怎麼看起來這麼累？
lines.simplified: 你今天怎么看起来这么累？
lines.pinyin: Nǐ jīntiān zěnme kàn qǐlái zhème lèi?
lines.english: Why do you look so tired today?

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 昨天晚上我們家寶貝一直哭，我以為她只是餓了。幸虧我先生發覺情況不對，立刻把她送到醫院，要不然就糟糕了。
lines.simplified: 昨天晚上我们家宝贝一直哭，我以为她只是饿了。幸亏我先生发觉情况不对，立刻把她送到医院，要不然就糟糕了。
lines.pinyin: Zuótiān wǎnshàng wǒmen jiā bǎobèi yìzhí kū, wǒ yǐwéi tā zhǐshì è le. Xìngkuī wǒ xiānshēng fājué qíngkuàng búduì, lìkè bǎ tā sòng dào yīyuàn, yàobùrán jiù zāogāo le.
lines.english: Last night our little one kept crying, and I thought she was just hungry. Luckily my husband sensed something was wrong and took her straight to the hospital; otherwise it would have been bad.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 醫生怎麼說？
lines.simplified: 医生怎么说？
lines.pinyin: Yīshēng zěnme shuō?
lines.english: What did the doctor say?

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 醫生說她發燒到三十九度。吃了藥已經好多了，可是我們整個晚上都沒睡。
lines.simplified: 医生说她发烧到三十九度。吃了药已经好多了，可是我们整个晚上都没睡。
lines.pinyin: Yīshēng shuō tā fāshāo dào sānshíjiǔ dù. Chī le yào yǐjīng hǎo duō le, kěshì wǒmen zhěng ge wǎnshàng dōu méi shuì.
lines.english: The doctor said she had a fever of thirty-nine degrees. She's much better after the medicine, but we didn't sleep all night.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 女的說「要不然就糟糕了」，表示什麼？
prompt.simplified: 女的说「要不然就糟糕了」，表示什么？
prompt.pinyin: Nǚ de shuō "yàobùrán jiù zāogāo le", biǎoshì shénme?
prompt.english: What does the woman mean by "otherwise it would have been bad"?

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 孩子的病可能會更嚴重
choices.simplified: 孩子的病可能会更严重
choices.pinyin: Háizi de bìng kěnéng huì gèng yánzhòng.
choices.english: The child's illness might have got worse.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Háizi huì yìzhí èzhe dùzi.
choices.english: The child would have stayed hungry.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Tāmen zhěng wǎn dōu méi bànfǎ shuì.
choices.english: They wouldn't have been able to sleep all night.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Tā xiānshēng huì guài tā bù xiǎoxīn.
choices.english: Her husband would blame her for being careless.

questions.why: 要不然 introduces what would have happened without the lucky event: had nobody taken the feverish baby (39 degrees) to hospital, her illness could have got worse. Hunger was only the woman's first wrong guess, and the sleepless night really happened; it is not the outcome they escaped.

focus.zh: 幸虧……，要不然……；假設的結果
focus.en: luckily…, otherwise…; what would have happened

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 妳怎麼現在才到？電影已經開始十分鐘了。
lines.simplified: 你怎么现在才到？电影已经开始十分钟了。
lines.pinyin: Nǐ zěnme xiànzài cái dào? Diànyǐng yǐjīng kāishǐ shí fēnzhōng le.
lines.english: Why are you only getting here now? The film started ten minutes ago.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 都是我室友害的。她一再保證五分鐘就好，結果光化妝就花了半個小時。
lines.simplified: 都是我室友害的。她一再保证五分钟就好，结果光化妆就花了半个小时。
lines.pinyin: Dōu shì wǒ shìyǒu hài de. Tā yízài bǎozhèng wǔ fēnzhōng jiù hǎo, jiéguǒ guāng huàzhuāng jiù huā le bàn ge xiǎoshí.
lines.english: It's all my roommate's fault. She kept promising she'd be ready in five minutes, and in the end her make-up alone took half an hour.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 那妳怎麼不自己先進去？
lines.simplified: 那你怎么不自己先进去？
lines.pinyin: Nà nǐ zěnme bú zìjǐ xiān jìnqù?
lines.english: Then why didn't you go in first on your own?

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 我們的票都在她的手機裡啊。她正在買飲料，馬上就過來。
lines.simplified: 我们的票都在她的手机里啊。她正在买饮料，马上就过来。
lines.pinyin: Wǒmen de piào dōu zài tā de shǒujī lǐ a. Tā zhèng zài mǎi yǐnliào, mǎshàng jiù guòlái.
lines.english: Our tickets are all on her phone. She's buying drinks right now and will be here in a moment.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 女的說「票都在她的手機裡」，表示什麼？
prompt.simplified: 女的说「票都在她的手机里」，表示什么？
prompt.pinyin: Nǚ de shuō "piào dōu zài tā de shǒujī lǐ", biǎoshì shénme?
prompt.english: What does the woman mean by "the tickets are all on her phone"?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Tā bù xiǎng yí ge rén xiān jìnchǎng.
choices.english: She didn't want to go in alone first.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 她忘了先購買自己的票
choices.simplified: 她忘了先购买自己的票
choices.pinyin: Tā wàng le xiān gòumǎi zìjǐ de piào.
choices.english: She forgot to buy her own ticket first.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 沒有室友她進不了電影院
choices.simplified: 没有室友她进不了电影院
choices.pinyin: Méiyǒu shìyǒu tā jìn bù liǎo diànyǐngyuàn.
choices.english: Without her roommate she couldn't get into the cinema.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 她們約好買完飲料再進去
choices.simplified: 她们约好买完饮料再进去
choices.pinyin: Tāmen yuē hǎo mǎi wán yǐnliào zài jìnqù.
choices.english: They had agreed to go in after buying drinks.

questions.why: She is answering 'why didn't you go in first?': both tickets were on the roommate's phone, so going in alone was impossible. That is how the roommate, who 一再 promised five minutes, 害 her, made her late. She gives a practical reason, not that she minded going in alone, and the drinks are what the roommate is doing now, not a plan they had made.

focus.en: to cause trouble for; again and again; what the speaker means

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 這個暑假我們一起去學游泳吧？
lines.simplified: 这个暑假我们一起去学游泳吧？
lines.pinyin: Zhège shǔjià wǒmen yìqǐ qù xué yóuyǒng ba?
lines.english: Shall we learn to swim together this summer holiday?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 我連在海邊玩水都害怕，更別說學游泳了。
lines.simplified: 我连在海边玩水都害怕，更别说学游泳了。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ lián zài hǎibiān wán shuǐ dōu hàipà, gèng bié shuō xué yóuyǒng le.
lines.english: I'm scared even of playing in the water at the beach, let alone learning to swim.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 這次是在學校的室內游泳池上課，水很淺，教練也會一直在旁邊教我們。
lines.simplified: 这次是在学校的室内游泳池上课，水很浅，教练也会一直在旁边教我们。
lines.pinyin: Zhè cì shì zài xuéxiào de shìnèi yóuyǒngchí shàngkè, shuǐ hěn qiǎn, jiàoliàn yě huì yìzhí zài pángbiān jiāo wǒmen.
lines.english: This time the lessons are in the school's indoor pool. The water is shallow, and the coach will be right beside us the whole time to teach us.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 這下子我好像不得不去了。
lines.simplified: 这下子我好像不得不去了。
lines.pinyin: Zhè xiàzi wǒ hǎoxiàng bùdébù qù le.
lines.english: Well, now it looks like I've got no choice but to go.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 男的最後是什麼意思？
prompt.simplified: 男的最后是什么意思？
prompt.pinyin: Nán de zuìhòu shì shénme yìsi?
prompt.english: What does the man mean at the end?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Tā háishì bù gǎn xià shuǐ.
choices.english: He still doesn't dare go into the water.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Tā bǐjiào xiǎng qù hǎibiān wán.
choices.english: He'd rather go and play at the beach.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Tā xiǎng zhǎo bié de jiàoliàn jiāo tā.
choices.english: He wants a different coach to teach him.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Tā dāyìng yìqǐ qù shàngkè le.
choices.english: He has agreed to go to the lessons with her.

questions.why: 這下子 marks a new situation that changes things: shallow water and a coach at his side leave him no reason to refuse, so 不得不去 is a joking yes. His fear (更別說學游泳了) was his first answer, before he heard about the pool.

focus.en: now (that this has happened); let alone…

intro.speaker: N
intro.traditional: 請聽一段對話，然後回答三個問題。
intro.simplified: 请听一段对话，然后回答三个问题。
intro.pinyin: Qǐng tīng yí duàn duìhuà, ránhòu huídá sān ge wèntí.
intro.english: Listen to a conversation, then answer three questions.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 七夕那天，我打算跟女朋友求婚，地點就選在百貨公司門口。
lines.simplified: 七夕那天，我打算跟女朋友求婚，地点就选在百货公司门口。
lines.pinyin: Qīxì nà tiān, wǒ dǎsuàn gēn nǚpéngyǒu qiúhūn, dìdiǎn jiù xuǎn zài bǎihuò gōngsī ménkǒu.
lines.english: On Qixi I'm planning to propose to my girlfriend, right outside the department store.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 那裡人那麼多，你是想讓大家都看到嗎？
lines.simplified: 那里人那么多，你是想让大家都看到吗？
lines.pinyin: Nàlǐ rén nàme duō, nǐ shì xiǎng ràng dàjiā dōu kàndào ma?
lines.english: There are so many people there. Do you want everyone to see?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 對啊，我還邀請了十幾個朋友，到時候一起拿著玫瑰花出來，一定很浪漫。
lines.simplified: 对啊，我还邀请了十几个朋友，到时候一起拿着玫瑰花出来，一定很浪漫。
lines.pinyin: Duì a, wǒ hái yāoqǐng le shí jǐ ge péngyǒu, dào shíhòu yìqǐ názhe méiguī huā chūlái, yídìng hěn làngmàn.
lines.english: Yes. I've also invited a dozen or so friends to come out together with roses at the right moment. It'll be so romantic.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 可是她個性那麼害羞，上次大家在餐廳幫她慶祝生日，她緊張得都快哭了。
lines.simplified: 可是她个性那么害羞，上次大家在餐厅帮她庆祝生日，她紧张得都快哭了。
lines.pinyin: Kěshì tā gèxìng nàme hàixiū, shàng cì dàjiā zài cāntīng bāng tā qìngzhù shēngrì, tā jǐnzhāng de dōu kuài kū le.
lines.english: But she's so shy. Last time everyone celebrated her birthday at a restaurant, she was so nervous she nearly cried.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 是我想得太天真了嗎？可是我已經準備兩個月了。
lines.simplified: 是我想得太天真了吗？可是我已经准备两个月了。
lines.pinyin: Shì wǒ xiǎng de tài tiānzhēn le ma? Kěshì wǒ yǐjīng zhǔnbèi liǎng ge yuè le.
lines.english: Was I being naive? But I've been preparing for two months.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 朋友們準備的花還是可以用啊。你在家親手做幾道菜，請他們把花放在門口就好。
lines.simplified: 朋友们准备的花还是可以用啊。你在家亲手做几道菜，请他们把花放在门口就好。
lines.pinyin: Péngyǒumen zhǔnbèi de huā háishì kěyǐ yòng a. Nǐ zài jiā qīnshǒu zuò jǐ dào cài, qǐng tāmen bǎ huā fàng zài ménkǒu jiù hǎo.
lines.english: You can still use the flowers your friends got ready. Cook a few dishes yourself at home and just ask them to leave the flowers at the door.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 也對。她在意的是我的心意，不是有多少觀眾。
lines.simplified: 也对。她在意的是我的心意，不是有多少观众。
lines.pinyin: Yě duì. Tā zàiyì de shì wǒ de xīnyì, bú shì yǒu duōshǎo guānzhòng.
lines.english: You're right. What she cares about is how I feel, not how big the audience is.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 男的本來打算在哪裡求婚？
prompt.simplified: 男的本来打算在哪里求婚？
prompt.pinyin: Nán de běnlái dǎsuàn zài nǎlǐ qiúhūn?
prompt.english: Where did the man first plan to propose?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Zài hěn duō rén jīngguò de dìfāng.
choices.english: Somewhere many people pass by.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Zài zìjǐ de jiā lǐ.
choices.english: In his own home.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Zài cháng qù de cāntīng lǐ.
choices.english: In a restaurant they often go to.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Zài péngyǒu de jiā ménkǒu.
choices.english: Outside a friend's door.

questions.why: His first plan was outside a department store, where, as she says, there are so many people: a place many people pass. Home is the new plan, the restaurant is where the birthday was, and the door is where the flowers will be left.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 女的為什麼覺得這個安排不好？
prompt.simplified: 女的为什么觉得这个安排不好？
prompt.pinyin: Nǚ de wèishénme juéde zhège ānpái bù hǎo?
prompt.english: Why does the woman think the plan is a bad idea?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Péngyǒu zhǔnbèi de shíjiān bú gòu.
choices.english: The friends haven't had enough time to prepare.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 怕女朋友提早知道計畫
choices.simplified: 怕女朋友提早知道计划
choices.pinyin: Pà nǚpéngyǒu tízǎo zhīdào jìhuà.
choices.english: She is afraid his girlfriend will find out about the plan early.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 女朋友不習慣被很多人注意
choices.simplified: 女朋友不习惯被很多人注意
choices.pinyin: Nǚpéngyǒu bù xíguàn bèi hěn duō rén zhùyì.
choices.english: His girlfriend isn't used to lots of people's attention.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 女朋友不喜歡慶祝生日
choices.simplified: 女朋友不喜欢庆祝生日
choices.pinyin: Nǚpéngyǒu bù xǐhuān qìngzhù shēngrì.
choices.english: His girlfriend doesn't like celebrating her birthday.

questions.why: She asks whether he wants everyone to see, then gives the reason: his girlfriend is shy and nearly cried when a group celebrated her birthday. It is the crowd's attention she cannot handle, not birthdays; the surprise being found out is never her worry, and the two months of preparing are his worry, not hers.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 男的最後有什麼想法？
prompt.simplified: 男的最后有什么想法？
prompt.pinyin: Nán de zuìhòu yǒu shénme xiǎngfǎ?
prompt.english: What does the man think in the end?

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 應該先問女朋友的意見
choices.simplified: 应该先问女朋友的意见
choices.pinyin: Yīnggāi xiān wèn nǚpéngyǒu de yìjiàn.
choices.english: He should ask his girlfriend's opinion first.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Zhēnxīn bǐ rènào gèng zhòngyào.
choices.english: Sincerity matters more than a big show.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Péngyǒu zhǔnbèi de dōu bú yòng le.
choices.english: None of what his friends prepared will be used.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Zài wàimiàn qiúhūn bǐjiào làngmàn.
choices.english: Proposing outside is more romantic.

questions.why: 她在意的是我的心意，不是有多少觀眾: what counts is that he means it, not a crowd. Asking her first is never mentioned, the friends' flowers will still be used at the door, and the romantic public proposal is the plan he gives up.

focus.en: the speaker's view; one's heartfelt feeling

intro.speaker: N
intro.traditional: 請聽一段對話，然後回答三個問題。
intro.simplified: 请听一段对话，然后回答三个问题。
intro.pinyin: Qǐng tīng yí duàn duìhuà, ránhòu huídá sān ge wèntí.
intro.english: Listen to a conversation, then answer three questions.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 你這個星期怎麼天天加班到十點？
lines.simplified: 你这个星期怎么天天加班到十点？
lines.pinyin: Nǐ zhège xīngqí zěnme tiāntiān jiābān dào shí diǎn?
lines.english: How come you've worked late until ten every day this week?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 上個月有個同事算錯了價錢，害一位老客人少付了好幾萬塊。
lines.simplified: 上个月有个同事算错了价钱，害一位老客人少付了好几万块。
lines.pinyin: Shàng ge yuè yǒu ge tóngshì suàn cuò le jiàqián, hài yí wèi lǎo kèrén shǎo fù le hǎo jǐ wàn kuài.
lines.english: Last month a colleague got a price wrong, so a long-standing customer paid tens of thousands less than he should have.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 那跟你有什麼關係？
lines.simplified: 那跟你有什么关系？
lines.pinyin: Nà gēn nǐ yǒu shénme guānxi?
lines.english: What does that have to do with you?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 經理說這是整個小組的責任，要我們按照新的方法，把這一年的資料全部重新檢查一遍。
lines.simplified: 经理说这是整个小组的责任，要我们按照新的方法，把这一年的资料全部重新检查一遍。
lines.pinyin: Jīnglǐ shuō zhè shì zhěng ge xiǎozǔ de zérèn, yào wǒmen ànzhào xīn de fāngfǎ, bǎ zhè yì nián de zīliào quánbù chóngxīn jiǎnchá yí biàn.
lines.english: The manager said it's the whole team's responsibility, and wants us to check all of this year's files again using a new method.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 犯錯的又不是你，為什麼要大家一起負責？
lines.simplified: 犯错的又不是你，为什么要大家一起负责？
lines.pinyin: Fàncuò de yòu bú shì nǐ, wèishénme yào dàjiā yìqǐ fùzé?
lines.english: You're not the one who made the mistake. Why should everyone take the blame?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 因為那份資料大家都看過，卻沒有一個人發現錯誤。
lines.simplified: 因为那份资料大家都看过，却没有一个人发现错误。
lines.pinyin: Yīnwèi nà fèn zīliào dàjiā dōu kàn guo, què méiyǒu yí ge rén fāxiàn cuòwù.
lines.english: Because all of us had looked at that file, yet not one person spotted the mistake.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 這樣說也有道理。可是天天這麼累，你還做得下去嗎？
lines.simplified: 这样说也有道理。可是天天这么累，你还做得下去吗？
lines.pinyin: Zhèyàng shuō yě yǒu dàolǐ. Kěshì tiāntiān zhème lèi, nǐ hái zuò de xiàqù ma?
lines.english: That makes sense. But being this tired every day, can you keep it up?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 只有這個月比較忙。而且經過這件事，我們做事都比以前小心多了。
lines.simplified: 只有这个月比较忙。而且经过这件事，我们做事都比以前小心多了。
lines.pinyin: Zhǐyǒu zhège yuè bǐjiào máng. Érqiě jīngguò zhè jiàn shì, wǒmen zuòshì dōu bǐ yǐqián xiǎoxīn duō le.
lines.english: It's only this month that's busy. Besides, after this we're all much more careful in our work than before.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 男的這個月要做什麼？
prompt.simplified: 男的这个月要做什么？
prompt.pinyin: Nán de zhège yuè yào zuò shénme?
prompt.english: What does the man have to do this month?

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 跟客人說明價錢的問題
choices.simplified: 跟客人说明价钱的问题
choices.pinyin: Gēn kèrén shuōmíng jiàqián de wèntí.
choices.english: Explain the price problem to the customer.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 算出客人少付了多少錢
choices.simplified: 算出客人少付了多少钱
choices.pinyin: Suàn chū kèrén shǎo fù le duōshǎo qián.
choices.english: Work out how much less the customer paid.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Jiāo tóngshì zěnme suàn qián.
choices.english: Teach his colleague how to do the sums.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 用新方法再看一次舊資料
choices.simplified: 用新方法再看一次旧资料
choices.pinyin: Yòng xīn fāngfǎ zài kàn yí cì jiù zīliào.
choices.english: Go through the old files again with a new method.

questions.why: 按照新的方法……重新檢查一遍: the manager wants the year's files checked again the new way. The client, the lost money and the colleague are all in the story, but none of them is the job he was given.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 經理為什麼要整個小組一起負責？
prompt.simplified: 经理为什么要整个小组一起负责？
prompt.pinyin: Jīnglǐ wèishénme yào zhěng ge xiǎozǔ yìqǐ fùzé?
prompt.english: Why does the manager hold the whole team responsible?

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 大家都沒做好檢查的工作
choices.simplified: 大家都没做好检查的工作
choices.pinyin: Dàjiā dōu méi zuò hǎo jiǎnchá de gōngzuò.
choices.english: Nobody did the checking properly.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Měi ge rén dōu suàn cuò le qián.
choices.english: Everyone got the sums wrong.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 經理想讓大家學新方法
choices.simplified: 经理想让大家学新方法
choices.pinyin: Jīnglǐ xiǎng ràng dàjiā xué xīn fāngfǎ.
choices.english: The manager wants everyone to learn the new method.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 那位同事一個人做不完
choices.simplified: 那位同事一个人做不完
choices.pinyin: Nà wèi tóngshì yí ge rén zuò bù wán.
choices.english: That colleague can't finish the work alone.

questions.why: Her 犯錯的又不是你 is answered two turns later: everyone had read the file, 卻 no one caught the mistake, so the checking failed for all of them. Only one colleague got the sums wrong, so 每個人都算錯了 overstates; the new method is what they must now use, not why they are to blame; and the workload is never given as the reason.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 男的對這件事有什麼看法？
prompt.simplified: 男的对这件事有什么看法？
prompt.pinyin: Nán de duì zhè jiàn shì yǒu shénme kànfǎ?
prompt.english: How does the man feel about all this?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Juéde zìjǐ bù yīnggāi fùzé.
choices.english: He thinks he shouldn't be held responsible.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Suīrán lèi, dàn yě yǒu shōuhuò.
choices.english: It's tiring, but he has gained something from it.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 打算這個月做完就離開
choices.simplified: 打算这个月做完就离开
choices.pinyin: Dǎsuàn zhège yuè zuò wán jiù líkāi.
choices.english: He plans to leave once this month is over.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Guài zìjǐ méiyǒu zǎo diǎn fāxiàn.
choices.english: He blames himself for not noticing sooner.

questions.why: Asked whether he can keep going (做得下去), he says the busy time is only this month and the team is now far more careful: tiring, but worth something. 'He shouldn't be responsible' is the woman's view, not his, and he never talks of leaving or blames himself.

focus.zh: 說話人的態度；V 下去
focus.en: the speaker's attitude; keep on doing

intro.speaker: N
intro.traditional: 請聽一段介紹，然後回答三個問題。
intro.simplified: 请听一段介绍，然后回答三个问题。
intro.pinyin: Qǐng tīng yí duàn jièshào, ránhòu huídá sān ge wèntí.
intro.english: Listen to an introduction, then answer three questions.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 各位，我們面前的這家早餐店，已經開了四十年了。
lines.simplified: 各位，我们面前的这家早餐店，已经开了四十年了。
lines.pinyin: Gèwèi, wǒmen miànqián de zhè jiā zǎocān diàn, yǐjīng kāi le sìshí nián le.
lines.english: Everyone, the breakfast shop in front of us has been open for forty years.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 老闆是一對七十多歲的夫婦，每天早上四點就起床，親手做包子。
lines.simplified: 老板是一对七十多岁的夫妇，每天早上四点就起床，亲手做包子。
lines.pinyin: Lǎobǎn shì yí duì qīshí duō suì de fūfù, měi tiān zǎoshàng sì diǎn jiù qǐchuáng, qīnshǒu zuò bāozi.
lines.english: It is run by a couple in their seventies, who get up at four every morning to make steamed buns by hand.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 附近鄰居都說，這裡的包子不但品質好，價格也幾十年沒變過。
lines.simplified: 附近邻居都说，这里的包子不但品质好，价格也几十年没变过。
lines.pinyin: Fùjìn línjū dōu shuō, zhèlǐ de bāozi búdàn pǐnzhí hǎo, jiàgé yě jǐ shí nián méi biàn guo.
lines.english: The neighbours all say the buns here are not only good quality; the price hasn't changed in decades either.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 可惜的是，這家店下個月底就要關門了。不少老顧客聽到這個消息，都難過得掉眼淚。
lines.simplified: 可惜的是，这家店下个月底就要关门了。不少老顾客听到这个消息，都难过得掉眼泪。
lines.pinyin: Kěxí de shì, zhè jiā diàn xià ge yuè dǐ jiù yào guānmén le. Bù shǎo lǎo gùkè tīngdào zhège xiāoxí, dōu nánguò de diào yǎnlèi.
lines.english: Sadly, the shop will close at the end of next month. When they heard the news, many regulars were so sad they cried.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 很多老顧客問他們為什麼不繼續做下去，老闆說，不是生意不好，而是太太的身體受不了這麼累的工作了。
lines.simplified: 很多老顾客问他们为什么不继续做下去，老板说，不是生意不好，而是太太的身体受不了这么累的工作了。
lines.pinyin: Hěn duō lǎo gùkè wèn tāmen wèishénme bú jìxù zuò xiàqù. Lǎobǎn shuō, bú shì shēngyì bù hǎo, ér shì tàitai de shēntǐ shòu bù liǎo zhème lèi de gōngzuò le.
lines.english: Many regulars have asked why they won't keep going. The owner says it isn't that business is bad; it's that his wife's health can't take such tiring work any more.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 他說：「她跟著我辛苦了一輩子，現在該換我照顧她了。」
lines.simplified: 他说：「她跟着我辛苦了一辈子，现在该换我照顾她了。」
lines.pinyin: Tā shuō: "Tā gēnzhe wǒ xīnkǔ le yíbèizi, xiànzài gāi huàn wǒ zhàogù tā le."
lines.english: He says: "She has worked hard beside me all her life. Now it's my turn to look after her."

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 所以等一下大家買包子的時候，別忘了跟他們說聲謝謝。
lines.simplified: 所以等一下大家买包子的时候，别忘了跟他们说声谢谢。
lines.pinyin: Suǒyǐ děng yíxià dàjiā mǎi bāozi de shíhòu, bié wàng le gēn tāmen shuō shēng xièxie.
lines.english: So in a moment, when you buy your buns, don't forget to say thank you to them.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 老顧客為什麼這麼喜歡這家店？
prompt.simplified: 老顾客为什么这么喜欢这家店？
prompt.pinyin: Lǎo gùkè wèishénme zhème xǐhuān zhè jiā diàn?
prompt.english: Why are the regulars so fond of this shop?

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 包子都是太太一個人做的
choices.simplified: 包子都是太太一个人做的
choices.pinyin: Bāozi dōu shì tàitai yí ge rén zuò de.
choices.english: The wife makes all the buns on her own.

Qùnián Qīxì, wǒ jì cuò yuēhuì shíjiān, ràng nǚpéngyǒu děng le liǎng ge xiǎoshí, jiù pǎo qù yéye jiā, yí ge rén zuò zài yuànzi lǐ bù shuōhuà. Yéye zuò zài pángbiān, zǐxì guānchá wǒ de yàngzi. Wǒ yǐwéi tā huì jiào wǒ mǎshàng dàoqiàn, tā fǎn'ér dài wǒ qù tián biān sànbù. Tā shuō zìjǐ niánqīng shí yě hěn tiānzhēn, yǐwéi làngmàn jiù gòu le; xiǎng yìqǐ zǒu xiàqù, chúle zhēnxīn, yě yào yǒu zhàogù duìfāng de zérèn. Tā hái shuō, chéngrèn cuòwù bù kěpà, zhòngyào de shì gǎnkuài shuō duìbùqǐ. Jǐnguǎn guò le yì nián, wǒ háishì jìde nà wǎn de huà.
passage.english: My grandparents live in the countryside and usually work in the fields. On Qixi many lovers go to restaurants, but every year they wait in the courtyard for the moon to rise. Last Qixi, I got the time of a date wrong and kept my girlfriend waiting two hours, then ran over to my grandfather's house and sat alone in the courtyard without a word. My grandfather sat beside me, carefully observing how I looked. I thought he would tell me to apologise at once; instead he took me for a walk by the fields. He said he had been just as naive when he was young, thinking romance was enough; to keep going together, besides sincerity, you also need the responsibility of looking after each other. He also said that admitting a mistake is nothing to fear; what matters is saying sorry quickly. Although a year has passed, I still remember what he said that night.

text.traditional:
提到農曆七月初七，人們就會想到古代的愛情故事：天上的仙女來到人間，愛上在田裡工作的青年，成了夫婦，還生了兩個寶貝，最後卻被天帝抓回去關起來，只能遠遠看著銀河對面的情人。不少人覺得這種故事太天真，跟現代人的生活無關。可是根據這幾年的出版與演出記錄，它年年被寫進文學和戲劇裡，讓作者有無窮的想像。
為什麼老故事能感動無數讀者與觀眾？原因就在故事背後。表面上看，這只是浪漫的愛情故事；如能深入思考，裡面寫的其實是人人都能理解的情況：渴望把愛的人留在身邊、被家人拒絕時的痛苦，還有在愛情和家庭責任之間的選擇。當仙女請求天帝讓她留下、流下眼淚時，大家看到的往往是自己一生中碰過的困難。
而且，每個時代的作者會按照自己的觀念，替老故事寫出新的結局。過去的人強調等待與團圓，現代戲劇卻常討論：為了地位或利益讓情人分開，是不是一種錯誤？人犯錯後又該怎麼面對？正因為這樣，老故事才一直留在大家心中。
text.simplified:
提到农历七月初七，人们就会想到古代的爱情故事：天上的仙女来到人间，爱上在田里工作的青年，成了夫妇，还生了两个宝贝，最后却被天帝抓回去关起来，只能远远看着银河对面的情人。不少人觉得这种故事太天真，跟现代人的生活无关。可是根据这几年的出版与演出记录，它年年被写进文学和戏剧里，让作者有无穷的想像。
为什么老故事能感动无数读者与观众？原因就在故事背后。表面上看，这只是浪漫的爱情故事；如能深入思考，里面写的其实是人人都能理解的情况：渴望把爱的人留在身边、被家人拒绝时的痛苦，还有在爱情和家庭责任之间的选择。当仙女请求天帝让她留下、流下眼泪时，大家看到的往往是自己一生中碰过的困难。
而且，每个时代的作者会按照自己的观念，替老故事写出新的结局。过去的人强调等待与团圆，现代戏剧却常讨论：为了地位或利益让情人分开，是不是一种错误？人犯错后又该怎么面对？正因为这样，老故事才一直留在大家心中。
text.pinyin: Tídào nónglì qī yuè chū qī, rénmen jiù huì xiǎngdào gǔdài de àiqíng gùshì: tiānshàng de xiānnǚ lái dào rénjiān, ài shàng zài tián lǐ gōngzuò de qīngnián, chéng le fūfù, hái shēng le liǎng ge bǎobèi, zuìhòu què bèi Tiāndì zhuā huíqù guān qǐlái, zhǐ néng yuǎnyuǎn kànzhe Yínhé duìmiàn de qíngrén. Bù shǎo rén juéde zhè zhǒng gùshì tài tiānzhēn, gēn xiàndài rén de shēnghuó wúguān. Kěshì gēnjù zhè jǐ nián de chūbǎn yǔ yǎnchū jìlù, tā niánnián bèi xiě jìn wénxué hé xìjù lǐ, ràng zuòzhě yǒu wúqióng de xiǎngxiàng. Wèishénme lǎo gùshì néng gǎndòng wúshù dúzhě yǔ guānzhòng? Yuányīn jiù zài gùshì bèihòu. Biǎomiàn shàng kàn, zhè zhǐ shì làngmàn de àiqíng gùshì; rú néng shēnrù sīkǎo, lǐmiàn xiě de qíshí shì rénrén dōu néng lǐjiě de qíngkuàng: kěwàng bǎ ài de rén liú zài shēnbiān, bèi jiārén jùjué shí de tòngkǔ, háiyǒu zài àiqíng hé jiātíng zérèn zhī jiān de xuǎnzé. Dāng xiānnǚ qǐngqiú Tiāndì ràng tā liú xià, liú xià yǎnlèi shí, dàjiā kàndào de wǎngwǎng shì zìjǐ yìshēng zhōng pèng guo de kùnnán. Érqiě, měi ge shídài de zuòzhě huì ànzhào zìjǐ de guānniàn, tì lǎo gùshì xiě chū xīn de jiéjú. Guòqù de rén qiángdiào děngdài yǔ tuányuán, xiàndài xìjù què cháng tǎolùn: wèile dìwèi huò lìyì ràng qíngrén fēnkāi, shì bú shì yì zhǒng cuòwù? Rén fàncuò hòu yòu gāi zěnme miànduì? Zhèng yīnwèi zhèyàng, lǎo gùshì cái yìzhí liú zài dàjiā xīn zhōng.
text.english:
When the seventh day of the seventh lunar month is mentioned, people think of the ancient love story: a fairy maiden from heaven comes to the human world, falls in love with a young man who works in the fields, marries him and has two precious children, yet is finally dragged back and locked up by the Emperor of Heaven, left only to gaze from afar across the Milky Way at her loved one. Many feel such a story is too naive and has nothing to do with people's lives today. Yet based on publishing and performance records of recent years, it is written into literature and drama year after year, leaving writers endless room for imagination.
Why can an old story move countless readers and audiences? The reason lies behind the story. On the surface it is just a romantic love story; if one thinks deeply, what is written inside is actually situations everyone can understand: longing to keep the person you love by your side, the pain of facing family disapproval, and the choice between love and family responsibility. When the fairy begs the Emperor of Heaven to let her stay and sheds tears, what people see is often the difficulties they have met in their own lives.
Moreover, writers in every era create new endings for the old story according to their own mindset. People in the past emphasized waiting and reunion, whereas modern plays often discuss whether separating lovers for status or gain is a mistake, and how one should face having done wrong. Precisely for this reason, old stories stay in people's hearts.

text.traditional:
每到情人節或農曆七月初七，商店為了商業利益，年年打廣告推銷很貴的禮物和大餐。可是根據一份對情侶與夫婦的調查，超過一半的人表示，慶祝節日不但沒有帶來快樂，反而成了負擔，甚至因為禮物或安排不合適而吵架。
一位深入觀察家庭與愛情二十年的教授認為，問題不是出在七夕習俗，也跟禮物是不是親手做無關。許多人有錯誤的觀念，以為只有在這特別的日子花錢，才能表達真心與愛；要是情人忘了準備，就覺得對方犯了錯、沒有盡到責任。當兩個人的關係只用一天的表現來決定，小誤會也會讓人難過得流淚。
教授比較了剛談戀愛的年輕情侶和結婚多年的夫婦，發現相處得很好的夫婦很少按照廣告的說法去慶祝節日。他們更重視平日的關心：記得對方什麼時候累、犯錯後誠實道歉，也願意一起照顧孩子和家裡。教授說，節日可以表達心意，卻代替不了平時的體貼；能走過一生的愛，從來不是只依靠一天建立的。
text.simplified:
每到情人节或农历七月初七，商店为了商业利益，年年打广告推销很贵的礼物和大餐。可是根据一份对情侣与夫妇的调查，超过一半的人表示，庆祝节日不但没有带来快乐，反而成了负担，甚至因为礼物或安排不合适而吵架。
一位深入观察家庭与爱情二十年的教授认为，问题不是出在七夕习俗，也跟礼物是不是亲手做无关。许多人有错误的观念，以为只有在这特别的日子花钱，才能表达真心与爱；要是情人忘了准备，就觉得对方犯了错、没有尽到责任。当两个人的关系只用一天的表现来决定，小误会也会让人难过得流泪。
教授比较了刚谈恋爱的年轻情侣和结婚多年的夫妇，发现相处得很好的夫妇很少按照广告的说法去庆祝节日。他们更重视平日的关心：记得对方什么时候累、犯错后诚实道歉，也愿意一起照顾孩子和家里。教授说，节日可以表达心意，却代替不了平时的体贴；能走过一生的爱，从来不是只依靠一天建立的。
text.pinyin: Měi dào Qíngrénjié huò nónglì qī yuè chū qī, shāngdiàn wèile shāngyè lìyì, niánnián dǎ guǎnggào tuīxiāo hěn guì de lǐwù hé dà cān. Kěshì gēnjù yí fèn duì qínglǚ yǔ fūfù de diàochá, chāoguò yíbàn de rén biǎoshì, qìngzhù jiérì búdàn méiyǒu dàilái kuàilè, fǎn'ér chéng le fùdān, shènzhì yīnwèi lǐwù huò ānpái bù héshì ér chǎojià. Yí wèi shēnrù guānchá jiātíng yǔ àiqíng èrshí nián de jiàoshòu rènwéi, wèntí bú shì chū zài Qīxì xísú, yě gēn lǐwù shì bú shì qīnshǒu zuò wúguān. Xǔduō rén yǒu cuòwù de guānniàn, yǐwéi zhǐyǒu zài zhè tèbié de rìzi huāqián, cái néng biǎodá zhēnxīn yǔ ài; yàoshi qíngrén wàng le zhǔnbèi, jiù juéde duìfāng fàn le cuò, méiyǒu jìndào zérèn. Dāng liǎng ge rén de guānxì zhǐ yòng yì tiān de biǎoxiàn lái juédìng, xiǎo wùhuì yě huì ràng rén nánguò de liúlèi. Jiàoshòu bǐjiào le gāng tánliàn'ài de niánqīng qínglǚ hé jiéhūn duō nián de fūfù, fāxiàn xiāngchǔ de hěn hǎo de fūfù hěn shǎo ànzhào guǎnggào de shuōfǎ qù qìngzhù jiérì. Tāmen gèng zhòngshì píngrì de guānxīn: jìde duìfāng shénme shíhòu lèi, fàncuò hòu chéngshí dàoqiàn, yě yuànyì yìqǐ zhàogù háizi hé jiā lǐ. Jiàoshòu shuō, jiérì kěyǐ biǎodá xīnyì, què dàitì bù liǎo píngshí de tǐtiē; néng zǒu guò yìshēng de ài, cónglái bú shì zhǐ yīkào yì tiān jiànlì de.
text.english:
Every Valentine's Day or seventh day of the seventh lunar month, shops advertise expensive gifts and big dinners year after year for commercial profit. Yet based on a survey of dating and married couples, more than half said celebrating holidays not only failed to bring happiness, it instead became a burden, and even led to arguments over unsuitable gifts or plans.
A professor who has closely observed family life and romance for twenty years believes that the problem lies neither in the Qixi custom nor in whether a gift is handmade. Many people hold a mistaken belief, thinking that only by spending money on this special day can they express sincerity and love; if their partner forgets to prepare, they feel the partner has done wrong and failed in a duty. When a relationship is judged by one single day's performance, even a small misunderstanding can make someone sad enough to cry.
The professor compared young couples who had just started dating with couples married for many years, and found that couples who get along well rarely celebrate holidays according to what ads say. They value everyday care more: remembering when the other is tired, apologizing honestly after making a mistake, and being willing to look after the children and the home together. The professor says holidays can express kind feelings, yet cannot replace daily thoughtfulness; love that lasts a lifetime is never built on a single day alone.

questions.why: Across the whole passage, the professor stresses that holidays cannot replace everyday care and thoughtfulness, and a lifelong relationship is never built on one day alone. Paragraph 2 explicitly states the issue has nothing to do with handmade gifts or the custom itself, and better holiday planning does not address judging love by one day.
